{{Otheruses|Chief Executive}}
'''''Adascorp Fiscal Period Financial Report and Outlook: Message from the Chief Executive''''' was a financial report released by [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]]&mdash;an [[Arkania/Legends|Arkanian]] medical corporation also known simply as Adascorp&mdash;during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The report, written by Adascorp's [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Arkoh Adasca]], touted Adascorp's financial success and prosperity despite the conflicts and explained its new expansions and endeavors, which included the [[Adascopolis Financial Exchange]], the [[Military Research and Development Division]], and its purchase of the [[Telerath Interstellar Banking Initiative]].<ref name="Message">{{KOTORbackups|17}}</ref>
